parameters: Back through the water gate? Not with the forge still
Heat like a hand pushing you back. A cavern of red rock
and rivers of fire, and along every wall, on racks, row on
row of empty armors waiting for someone to fill them.
Hundreds of people in chains work the bellows and the
I've been here. I know I've been here.

Heat. Darkness. A hammer, very close. A woman's voice,
cracked and desperate, right against the metal:
"Wake up, Falin. Please. Please, wake up."
…I heard that. The first thing I ever heard.
Then the one who scratched these names woke you. Find
her, and you'll have the story you were afraid of.

At the great anvil, in the light of the furnace, a smith
three heads taller than any man lowers a hammer the
size of a door. Its skin is cracked like a cooling crust.
More metal. Good. Lie down on the anvil. Hold still.
You will make a fine shell.
Rank C, my Lord: one above us. It's the forge's heart.
The Aschenschmied falls across its own anvil and cracks
apart like a clinker. All over the cavern, hammers stop.
Everyone! It's dead! The army is in the city: out,
…You. The plate. I know that plate.
Nishiki Mariko. I scratched every name. When they
brought the dead in to fill the shells, I asked each one
his name, if he could still talk, and I wrote it inside,
so somebody would remember who went in.
The first night, they brought a girl. Your name was the
only thing she could say. Falin. Falin. She was so cold.
The Vogt put her into that shell with his book, and
the shell didn't move. None of them move on their own.
I sat by it all night with my hand on the metal and
begged it to wake up. And it did. It stood up and walked
through the fire, and nobody could stop it.
I don't know. The book of names burned the night the
city fell. She had a soldier's hands. She was young.
Then I don't have a story. Just a name, and you.
That's more than any of the others got.
Mama. Is Papa here? You said Papa would come.
…Eiji? Did my Eiji send you? The Vogt said he signed.
He said Eiji signed for us, and we'd go home.
He tried to buy you back. It cost him everything.
He's at the Wallfeste, madam. The contract took him.
He was thinking of you both when it did.
It's all right, Aya. It's all right. We're going home.
Papa got us out. Papa got us out.
The army's at the south breach. Yukimura Saki is in the
camp, the Wall's healer. Go to her. She's waiting.
The winch house, my Lord. Up the stair at the far end.
Rin is waiting at her gate.

parameters.desc: The forge is out and the workers are free. Up the stair behind the furnace to the winch house: open the citadel gate for Rin.
